(sec-module-misc.symbolicexport)=
# Module: misc.symbolicExport

Writes symbolic expressions and recorded symbolic user functions as code, from the structure of their flat
program (#3087, #3088): exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgramData(expressions) or
UserFunction.GetFlatProgramData(). Entry k of its 'operations' is node k of the recording, the tK of
GetFlatProgram(); an operation refers to its operands by their numbers, which are always smaller than k.
The formats:
'Python'   the text of GetFlatProgram() and str(), not executable (bare function names);
'symbolic' Python with exudyn.symbolic: called with symbolic arguments, it records the same graph;
'numpy'    Python with numpy, runs without Exudyn;
'sympy'    Python that builds sympy expressions; sympy writes C, C++, Fortran, Julia, Matlab, LaTeX, ...
Every format computes what Exudyn computes: mod is C fmod, round rounds halves away from zero, a comparison
is the number 0 or 1, IfThenElse is true for a condition other than 0.
exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgram(..., format=...), UserFunction.GetFlatProgram(format=...) and
ToString(format=...) of exudyn.symbolic.Real, Vector and Matrix call Write(); the format 'Python' of
GetFlatProgram() and ToString() is written by C++, and Write() gives the same text.

- **Author**: Johannes Gerstmayr
- **Date**: 2026-10-25 (created)

(sec-symbolicexport-write)=
## Function: Write

[`Write(data, format = 'Python', flatten = True, name = '', expressionOnly = False)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicExport.py#L171)

- **function description**: write the flat program of symbolic expressions or of a recorded user function as code; for exudyn.symbolic.Real, Vector and Matrix, ToString(format) calls it, for user functions and expressions GetFlatProgram(format=...)
- **input**:
  - `data`: the structure of exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgramData(...) or UserFunction.GetFlatProgramData()
  - `format`: 'Python' (the text of GetFlatProgram()), 'symbolic', 'numpy' or 'sympy' (executable Python)
  - `flatten`: True: one line per operation, each node computed once; False: each result as one expression
  - `name`: the name of the function of an executable format; default: the name of the user function, or F
  - `expressionOnly`: True: only the expression of the first result, as ToString() gives it
- **output**: the code as str; for an executable format a function with the arguments of the user function, or of the named variables of the expressions, and the variables of exudyn.symbolic.variables as keyword arguments


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicExportTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicExportTest.py) (TM)

## Function: ToFunction

[`ToFunction(data, format = 'numpy', flatten = True)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicExport.py#L233)

- **function description**: the Python function of an executable format, as Write() gives it as text
- **input**:
  - `data`: the structure of exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgramData(...) or UserFunction.GetFlatProgramData()
  - `format`: 'symbolic', 'numpy' or 'sympy'
  - `flatten`: as in Write()
- **output**: the function, with the arguments of the user function or of the named variables

(sec-symbolicexport-tosympy)=
## Function: ToSympy

[`ToSympy(data)`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/exudyn/misc/symbolicExport.py#L251)

- **function description**: the results as sympy expressions, with a sympy symbol per argument: x for a number, the components q[0], q[1], ... of a vector q as a column sympy.Matrix, M[0][0], ... of a matrix M; sympy must be installed
- **input**:
  - `data`: the structure of exudyn.symbolic.GetFlatProgramData(...) or UserFunction.GetFlatProgramData()
- **output**: (arguments, results): a dict of the argument names to their symbols (None for the MainSystem) and the list of the results; a variable of exudyn.symbolic.variables is a symbol as well


Relevant Examples (Ex) and TestModels (TM) with weblink to github: [`symbolicExportTest.py`](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/blob/master/python/TestModels/symbolicExportTest.py) (TM)
